Ever heard of cryptocurrency or blockchain but never really understood what they are?

Or maybe you've heard names like Bitcoin, Ethereum, or Solana but never had the chance to explore how they actually work?

Solana Across Campuses is a student-focused initiative bringing an introduction to blockchain technology and the Solana ecosystem directly to university campuses.

The goal is simple: learn, explore, and experience the technology yourself.

During the session, we'll break down what blockchain and cryptocurrency actually mean in simple terms, introduce you to Solana, show you how digital wallets work, and demonstrate some real applications built using this technology.

Whether you're a computer science student, designer, entrepreneur, finance enthusiast, or simply someone curious about new technology, you're welcome.

No prior experience. No technical background. Just curiosity.

🌐 What is Blockchain?

We'll start from the very beginning.


• What exactly is a blockchain?
• Why do people use it?
• How is it different from a normal database?
• Where is cryptocurrency used?
• What problems can this technology solve?

No complicated terminology — we'll keep it simple and practical.

• What Solana is

• Why developers and startups are interested in it
• How students can start exploring the ecosystem

• What a digital wallet is

Blockchain isn't just about buying and selling cryptocurrency.

We'll demonstrate some of the applications being built using blockchain technology and show how the ecosystem is being used by developers, creators, entrepreneurs, and communities.

💡 Opportunities for Students

We'll also introduce opportunities available in the ecosystem, including:

description:
## How does Bitcoin work without a bank or a central server? And what actually happens when you send a bitcoin transaction?

Join Bitshala for a beginner-friendly workshop exploring how Bitcoin works under the hood. We’ll break down the key ideas in simple language, follow a transaction through the network, and guide you through creating and sending one yourself.

You’ll use Bitcoin’s test network, so you can experiment without using real bitcoin. No prior coding or Bitcoin knowledge required.

• Blocks and mining: How transactions are grouped into blocks, what miners do, and how the network agrees on a shared transaction history.

name: Bitcoin Wallets: Keys, Transactions, and the Mempool | Chandigarh
description:
## When you click "Send," your wallet doesn't transfer money, it broadcasts a cryptographic signature directly to a global, ownerless network.

Join us for a deep dive into the inner workings of Bitcoin wallets! Whether you're a developer, a curious Bitcoiner, or someone wanting to understand what happens under the hood when you click "Send," this meetup is for you.

We will break down how wallets manage your secret keys, how transactions are constructed and signed, and how they navigate the mempool to reach finality on the blockchain.


## AGENDA


• Public vs. Private Keys: How cryptographic key pairs prove ownership.
• Seed Phrases & HD Wallets: How 12 to 24 words can restore all your funds across multiple addresses.
• Key Management Best Practices: Hot wallets vs. Cold storage and multisig setups.
• UTXO Model: How Bitcoin tracks ownership using Unspent Transaction Outputs instead of balance accounts.
• Transaction Anatomy: Inputs, Outputs, ScriptPubKey, and Digital Signatures.
• Fee Estimation & RBF: Understanding mining fees and Replace-By-Fee (RBF) mechanics.
• What is the Mempool?: How nodes receive, validate, and queue unconfirmed transactions.
• Fee Rates & Priority: How miners select transactions based on satoshis per vByte (sat/vB).
• Congestion & Confirmation: What happens during high-traffic periods and how to navigate stuck transactions.

Ready for the Run is a community-first meetup circuit bringing together builders, investors, traders, founders, and researchers for real conversations on where AI and Web3 are headed next. Expect candid discussions, live polling, and networking with people who are actually building and betting on this space.


## Hyderabad carries the theme Innovation. The city's tech backbone makes the word an easy fit - but this stop is about pressure-testing it, not repeating it: what's actually shipping in AI & Web3, not just being claimed.

This isn't a pitch fest. It's a space for honest takes, contrarian views, and collective intelligence - capturing how each city's community is thinking, positioning, and preparing right now, city by city, across a 9-city run - maybe more

The circuit is co-led by Raajeev Anand (TechHybr (https://x.com/techhybrx)), bringing his on-ground Web3 & AI community reach into every stop of the run.

Whether you're deep in the trenches or just AI & Web3-curious, come add your voice to the conversation.

Ready? Let's run.


## Partners

Their presence broadens the credibility of the conversation and adds real-world asset variety to the ecosystem represented here.

## Co-Host


## Raajeev Anand (@cryptomargofficial (https://www.instagram.com/cryptomargofficial/))/ TechHybr

Raajeev Anand is an India-based Web3 & AI social media influencer and digital entrepreneur, building at the intersection of emerging technology and community-driven education.

Through TechHybr, his vision is to build a value-driven ecosystem, powered by Web3 and AI, that brings together content, development, and scale — making complex technology accessible, practical, and actionable for creators, students, and businesses across India.

Insta (https://www.instagram.com/cryptomargofficial/) | X (https://x.com/raajeevanand) | LinkedIn (https://www.linkedin.com/in/raajeevanand/)


## About Infini3

Infini3 is an events and media platform, built as an IP of 28° North - a boutique strategic advisory firm for early-stage Web3 & AI startups. It brings India's crypto and Web3 ecosystem together across formats, from large-scale IRL events and community meetups to online panels, podcasts, and AMAs. Infini3 turns community participation into collective intelligence - capturing sentiment, insights, and signals from the people actually building and investing in this space.

X (https://x.com/infini3_) | Telegram (https://t.me/goinfini3) | Instagram (https://www.instagram.com/goinfini3)


## About 28° North

28° North is a boutique strategic advisory firm for early-stage Web3 and AI startups, working on scope-based mandates across positioning, product, growth, community, and fundraising. It operates with an operator-first, KRA-driven approach - practical strategy built to execute, not just present. Infini3 is its events and media arm, extending that same structured, outcome-focused thinking into community-building and content formats.
